mapper.insert: INSERT INTO environment_variable (tenant_id, name, credential_ref, description, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{credentialRef}, #{description}, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, name, description, gmt_create, gmt_modified, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted, version FROM environment_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY name, id

SELECT id, tenant_id, name, credential_ref, description, gmt_create, gmt_modified, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted, version FROM environment_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, name, credential_ref, description, gmt_create, gmt_modified, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted, version FROM environment_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, tenant_id, name, description, gmt_create, gmt_modified, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted, version FROM environment_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name}) AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE environment_variable SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND version = #{version}

UPDATE environment_variable SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, credential_ref = #{credentialRef}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS agentId, a.name AS agentName, av.id AS agentVersionId, av.version_no AS versionNo, CASE WHEN a.online_version_id = av.id THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'EDITING' END AS refType FROM agent_environment_variable_ref ref JOIN agent_version av ON av.id = ref.agent_version_id AND av.tenant_id = #{tenantId} JOIN agent a ON a.id = av.agent_id AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE ref.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ref.environment_variable_id = #{environmentVariableId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND av.is_deleted = 0 AND (a.online_version_id = av.id OR a.editing_version_id = av.id) ORDER BY a.id, av.version_no
